$meta.name: DrinkAid EDM Design System
$meta.supersedes: 1.0.0 — built on the Klaviyo '[Pills] — DESIGNED' templates, which use a dark charcoal surface that does not match any email the client has actually sent. v2 rebuilds on the real sends.
sources: Welcome Flow EDM.pdf — 14 emails, rendered and colour-sampled
DrinkAid EDM.pdf — 70 emails, rendered and colour-sampled
Klaviyo account VagrHA — hosted asset library
$meta.posture: HYBRID. The palette, components and structure are taken from live sends. Where those sends are inconsistent (type scale, spacing, button treatment), this file picks one and standardises it. Treat the standardisation as a proposal for client sign-off, not as an established fact.

color.$note: Sampled from live sends. Percentages are share of rendered pixels across a sample of standard-length emails.

page.use: Default email surface. Most campaign emails are white.

cream.use: Alternate body surface. Used for letter/founder-note emails and as a calm section band.

forest.use: THE structural colour. Logo pill, header bar, primary buttons, all headline and body text, footer icons.

mint.use: Soft panels, quote and explainer cards, the footer trust bar.

lime.use: Accent. Announcement bars, button text on forest, bullet glyphs, stars, the dot in the logo, the offset shadow under outline buttons. Small quantity, high impact — do not flood it.

forest_soft.use: Lighter forest for large fills and gradients where flat #08230F reads heavy.

text_body.use: Body copy. Yes — the same forest as structure. This brand does not use grey body text.

text_muted.use: Captions, legal, fine print. Derived, not sampled — used sparingly.

text_on_forest.use: Copy on forest fills. Lime is for emphasis only, never full paragraphs.

warm_cream.use: Occasional warm card fill seen in seasonal sends.

hairline.use: Dividers and card borders on white/cream.

seasonal_palettes.$note: Live sends deliberately leave the core palette for seasonal moments. This is intentional brand behaviour, not a violation. Sampled examples:
seasonal_palettes.rule: A seasonal email may change surface, accent and headline typeface. It must still carry the forest logo pill at the top and the standard footer at the bottom.

type.$font_note: The brand brief supplied is a strategy document and specifies no typeface. Live emails use a geometric sans with a true italic. Poppins is the closest widely-available match and is already used in the Klaviyo templates. Confirm the official face with the client before any print or web work — for email it barely matters, since Klaviyo strips webfonts and most clients fall back to Segoe UI / Arial.

h1_italic.use: The brand's signature move — second line of a headline set in italic.

rules.note: Vertical rhythm is padding-top only. No block sets padding-bottom, so any block can be deleted without leaving an orphaned gap.

logo_pill.logo_color: mint or white, with the lime dot in the wordmark
logo_pill.use: The brand's most consistent signature. Present at the top of nearly every send, including seasonal.

header_bar.use: Alternate to the logo pill — a full-width forest band with the logo centred. Used on letter/founder emails.

announce_bar.use: Top-of-email offer strip: 'GET XX% OFF DRINKAID + FREE SHIPPING'. Max one, and only above the logo.

button_lime.use: Alternate CTA when sitting on a forest or photographic section.

button_outline.use: Secondary CTA. The lime offset shadow is a brand signature — keep it.

bubble_label.use: Pill labels overlaid on product photography — 'HATE HANGOVERS?', 'WANT DEEPER SLEEP?'. Must be baked into the image; CSS overlays do not work in email.

trust_bar.right: forest square icon + 'PRODUCT OF SINGAPORE.' + legal address

social_row.style: forest circular outline icons with adjacent text links, on white
